maps.name: U.S. House districts — Georgia

maps.name: Georgia House districts
maps.description: All 180 Georgia House districts, using the Census Bureau’s 2026 state legislative boundaries. Search Bibb in the directory for districts intersecting Macon-Bibb.

maps.name: Georgia Senate districts
maps.description: All 56 Georgia Senate districts, using the Census Bureau’s 2026 state legislative boundaries. Search Bibb in the directory for districts intersecting Macon-Bibb.

maps.name: Georgia PSC residency districts
maps.description: Five commissioner residency districts derived from the enacted PSC-2022 county assignments and official Census county GIS. Commissioners must live in their district; voters statewide elect each commissioner. Bibb County is in District 1.

maps.name: U.S. Senate & statewide offices
maps.description: Both U.S. senators represent all of Georgia. This state boundary also provides geographic context for statewide offices; there are no separate U.S. Senate districts within the state.

maps.name: MBCTA Rapid service area
maps.description: Published on-demand service zones from MBCTA Rapid’s own map: Downtown, South, East and Northwest Bibb. Both pickup and destination must be inside active service areas.

maps.name: Schools by type
maps.description: 43 district-listed locations, grouped by their official source type. Toggle elementary, middle, high, pre-K, administration and specialty locations independently.

maps.name: Elementary attendance zones

maps.name: High attendance zones

maps.name: School-board districts

maps.name: Macon-Bibb transit
maps.description: Official scheduled bus routes and stops from the transit authority’s GTFS feed. Route colors follow the authority’s data; this is not a live-arrival map.
